data.name: Last Breath
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Last Breath is a solo/cooperative terraforming survival game where you and your friends must bring a dead planet back to life. Dig deep, build smart, and fight to restore a world that has lost everything.

After centuries of pollution and war, the surface is barren and toxic. But beneath the dust lies the potential for new life. Armed with shovels, machines, and raw determination, your team will carve tunnels, extract resources, and construct the foundations of a reborn ecosystem.

Key Features:

  • Cooperative Gameplay: Work together online to explore, survive, and rebuild. Share resources, machines, and progress as a team.

  • Digging and Terraforming: Break through layers of terrain to uncover resources, clear space, and sculpt the environment to your advantage.

  • Survival and Strategy: Balance power, oxygen, and food as you expand your base in a hostile world.

  • Modular Machines and Automation: Set up extractors, generators, and processing units to automate your operations and accelerate growth.

  • Dynamic Environment: Watch the world change as you fight back the wasteland and regrow forests, lakes, and clean air.

The future of the planet is in your hands. Will you restore it or let it die for good?
